assumptions.E1_modulator_rate: unpublished; 16, 32 and 64 x fs all evaluated (crystal-locked multiples)
assumptions.E2_dac_image_level: zero-order hold at the modulator rate: image at j*f_mod +- f is |sinc(fk/f_mod)/sinc(f/f_mod)| of the tone before the U5 pole (pessimistic; a semi-digital FIR reconstruction would be lower)
assumptions.E3_adc_samples_at_f_mod: switched-capacitor-like sampling at f_mod: components within the decimation passband of k*f_mod fold in unattenuated (a continuous-time modulator would add anti-alias rejection)
assumptions.E4_transition_band: 0.456-0.571 fs attenuation unpublished: counted as 0 dB
assumptions.E7_ripple: ripple_chain.py corners: rails, LDO and op-amp PSRR exactly as Rev D (Rev D loads, which include the removed FDA bias current: conservative)
assumptions.E9_adc_stf_notch: SBAA377 (TLV320ADCx140 family, same TI audio ADC architecture): the modulator signal transfer function has notches at N*FMOD that attenuate N*FMOD +- 20 kHz by > 100 dB. Credited only as a variant, and only for tones <= 20 kHz; TAC5112 wideband mode is not covered by that note
assumptions.E8_amplifiers: ideal followers, TIA and source driver at the image frequencies (OPA2810/OPA810 GBW 70 MHz against 3-12 MHz images: loop gain 6-23, ESTIMATE)
